name: CSOD
notes: The anonymous visitor token comes from the career page itself and is sent only to the platform's own API; no login.

name: Dayforce
notes: Reads the anonymous CSRF token the site issues to every visitor; no challenge is served. Descriptions from the list are cut short on long postings.

name: Dover
blocked: the job data endpoints are disallowed by robots.txt; only job URLs are allowed

name: Freshteam
notes: Some boards' schema.org data may swap region and city.

name: GoHire
notes: Board ids are case-sensitive.

name: JazzHR
notes: A feed over the 10 MB response cap (Crunch Fitness, 843 jobs) cannot be read; boards are listed in app.jazz.co's public sitemaps

name: Paycom
blocked: robots.txt disallows the search endpoint that lists jobs (only single known postings are allowed) and there is no sitemap, so jobs cannot be enumerated without ignoring it.

name: Paycor
blocked: robots.txt on recruitingbypaycor.com disallows everything

name: Rival
notes: robots.txt asks for a 10-second crawl delay, so a full crawl is slow

name: SmartRecruiters
blocked: robots.txt turns away every crawler except LinkedIn's

name: talentReef
notes: Reads the public search host that talentReef's own career page calls for every visitor (its name says internal, but it is the production address, answers anonymous requests and has no robots.txt rules).

name: TriNet
notes: Robots.txt signals ai-train=no: ERIO indexes these jobs for search only and never trains a model on them.

name: UltiPro
notes: robots.txt disallows the search API, so only the featured jobs on each board page (2 to 20) are read.

name: Pandapé
notes: Reads the career site's job list and each job page's schema.org JobPosting; robots.txt asks only that /Apply/ is left alone.

name: Factorial
notes: Reads the tenant sitemap and each job page's schema.org JobPosting. Only Factorial's own career site was found live; other customers' career pages were not located.

name: TRAFFIT
notes: Reads the public JSON list every TRAFFIT career site serves; the employer is not named in it, so the board's company is used.

name: Emply
notes: Reads the career site's own vacancy search call; the page names the list to read. Open-application (talent pool) entries are skipped. The sitemap lists no jobs.

name: HiringRoom
notes: No feed or structured data: reads the server-rendered job list and job pages. The page gives no posting date.

name: coveto
notes: Reads the tenant sitemap and each job page's schema.org JobPosting; customers on their own domain are added by sitemap address.

name: JobKit
notes: Only one populated board exists (jobs.rubyonrails.org); about 20 other JobKit boards are empty.

name: JobBoardFire
notes: Cloudflare answers some job pages with HTTP 429, so a fast crawl can read part of a board.

name: Talenetic
blocked: hosted boards disallow everything in robots.txt and require sign-in

name: CareerSiteCloud
notes: Only wpp.careersitecloud.com allows crawlers; every other tenant checked disallows everything or refuses requests.

name: JobBoard.com
notes: Only one live board found: the vendor lists no customers, and every showcase site is dead or off the platform.

name: Artha
blocked: Job pages sit behind a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) and the lists render client-side; reading them would mean working around bot protection.

name: eJobBoard
blocked: No live job board running the software could be found: the vendor's sites are dead or parked, so there is nothing to read.

name: ejobsitesoftware.com
notes: connectagri.com was dropped as an example: its jobs link to a private address, which ERIO rejects.

name: Arbeitnow
notes: Free public API, no access key. Credit: link back to Arbeitnow.com (its terms, section 11); every job links to its Arbeitnow page.

name: Remote OK
notes: Public JSON feed, no access key. Credit: a followed link back to the job on Remote OK and a mention of Remote OK as the source (its API terms); the Remote OK logo is not used.

name: We Work Remotely
notes: Public RSS feed. Credit: attribute the links back to We Work Remotely (its feed page); every job links to its We Work Remotely page.

name: Jobicy
notes: Public Jobs API, no access key; lists the last 7 days. Credit: Jobicy is named as the original source and the job links to its Jobicy listing (its fair-use rules).

name: Working Nomads
notes: The public JSON feed its site links as API, no access key; it states no attribution rule, so Working Nomads is credited anyway and every job links to its Working Nomads page. Its terms say nothing about reading the feed; worth a written yes before launch.

name: Python.org Jobs
notes: The Python Job Board's public RSS feed (20 newest jobs, no posted date). Credit: Python Job Board (Python Software Foundation) and a link to the job on python.org. It publishes no reuse terms for the feed beyond offering it for subscription; worth a written yes before launch.

name: Arbetsformedlingen (Sweden)
notes: The Swedish Public Employment Service's JobSearch API: no access key, ads licensed CC0. Credit given anyway: Arbetsformedlingen / JobTech. The API pages at most 2,100 ads, so a crawl reads the newest ones and is reported as partial.

name: EURES (European Job Mobility Portal)
notes: The portal's public vacancy search, no access key. Credit: re-use is authorised when the European Labour Authority (EURES) is acknowledged as the source; the EURES logo is not used. Its robots.txt asks for 10 seconds between requests, so a crawl reads the newest 250 jobs and is reported as partial.

name: Werken voor Nederland
notes: Dutch central government vacancies, read from each vacancy page's structured data and text. Its copyright page puts the content under CC0 (no credit required); photos excluded, and the Rijksoverheid must not appear to endorse a derived work. A crawl reads the first 200 vacancies of its sitemap and is reported as partial.

name: Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit (Germany)
blocked: The Jobsuche API answers 403 without an access key header; the key is one constant value printed in its documentation, which counts as a credential, so it is not used. Ask the agency for terms that allow reading without one.

name: NAV (Norway)
blocked: The Arbeidsplassen job feed answers 401 without a bearer token that has to be requested from NAV, so it needs a credential and is not built. Norwegian vacancies are partly covered through EURES.

name: Himalayas
blocked: Its API needs no key, but its API terms allow showing jobs only on sites you operate and forbid passing them on to other job boards, aggregators or job search engines, including through feeds; ERIO's public API and assistant tools would pass them on. Needs a decision, or a written permission from the service.

name: MyCareersFuture (Singapore)
blocked: Its terms of use reserve all rights in the site content and forbid reproducing, publicly displaying or otherwise using it except as the terms or the employer allow; nothing allows listing the jobs elsewhere. Ask the Singapore Workforce Development Agency for permission.

name: Cryptocurrency Jobs
blocked: Its terms reserve all rights in the content and forbid commercial use without a licence; the feed it serves carries only a one-line excerpt anyway.

name: Remotive
blocked: Its robots.txt disallows /api/ and the job pages, where its public API and feeds live, so there is no path ERIO may read.

name: Gemeentebanen (Netherlands)
blocked: Its only published terms are supplier terms for the municipalities that buy its career sites; nothing lets third parties read and show the listings, and no feed is offered. Ask Jobsrepublic.nl for permission.

name: Instaffo
notes: Jobs from Instaffo (jobs.instaffo.com); each links back to its Instaffo page. Reads the English job pages' schema.org JobPosting from the jobs sitemap; its robots.txt allows them.

name: Jobberman
notes: Jobs from Jobberman (Nigeria); each links back to its Jobberman listing. Reads the listings sitemaps its robots.txt names and each listing's schema.org JobPosting.

name: BrighterMonday
notes: Jobs from BrighterMonday (Kenya, Uganda), the same platform as Jobberman; each links back to its listing. Reads the listings sitemaps its robots.txt names and each listing's schema.org JobPosting.

name: Torre
notes: Jobs from Torre (torre.ai); each links back to its Torre post. Reads the sitemap and each /post/ page's schema.org JobPosting; the /api/ paths robots.txt disallows are not used.

name: MyJobMag Africa
notes: Jobs from MyJobMag (Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa); each links back to MyJobMag. Reads the aggregate feed the site publishes for job aggregators.

name: Jobnet (Denmark)
blocked: Jobnet (the Danish state job portal) serves no robots.txt or sitemap to crawlers (they redirect to an error page), publishes no feed or documented API, and its job search runs on a back end made for its own app; ask the Danish Agency for Labour Market and Recruitment (STAR) for access.

name: Apploi
notes: Reads the server-rendered company page on apply-jobs.apploi.com (robots.txt allows it) and the schema.org JobPosting on each job page; 15 jobs a page, up to 10 pages. The jobs.apploi.com app is not read: its job search calls an API with an Authorization bearer header.

name: Sólides
notes: Reads the portal's own public list, vagas.solides.com.br/api/vacancies (robots.txt allows all), the newest 500 jobs a crawl out of tens of thousands, so it is reported as a partial read. Jobs link to vagas.solides.com.br.

name: InHire
notes: Reads the public career-page API documented at docs.inhire.com.br (GET api.inhire.app/job-posts/public/pages with the X-Tenant header, the start of the tenant's {tenant}.inhire.app address). The list has no descriptions.

name: Recrutei
notes: Reads Recrutei Empregos, the job board of Recrutei customers: the sitemap of job pages and the schema.org JobPosting on each (robots.txt allows both). 200 pages a crawl, so large boards are partial. Companies' own jobs.recrutei.com.br pages list jobs through a POST API and are not read.

name: Senior Portal de Talentos
notes: Reads the anonymous searchVacancies query the portal's own pages call (no sign-in, no robots.txt on the host): every employer's jobs, 100 a page, up to 10 pages a crawl (partial). The list has no descriptions. Jobs link to {tenant}.portaldetalentos.senior.com.br.

name: eArcu
blocked: robots.txt disallows */action/* and */ajaxaction/*, which the career sites' job search and paging use (only the first result page renders without them), and there is no sitemap or feed.

name: eRecruiter
blocked: no public way to list a customer's jobs was found: eRecruiter's own board (jobs.erecruiter.net) shows no open jobs and no JSON-LD, there is no shared host, sitemap or feed, and customers' career sites run on their own domains.

name: Intervieweb / Inrecruiting
notes: Reads the first page (15 jobs) of a company's /{company}/it/career page and the schema.org JobPosting on each job page; a board with more pages is a partial read, because later pages need a script-issued CSRF POST. Some companies' job pages carry no JobPosting data (colombinispa, colorobbia) and fail. App.php?LAC= addresses are not used (robots.txt disallows them).

name: The Hub
notes: Reads thehub.io's sitemap of job pages and the schema.org JobPosting on each (robots.txt allows both); 200 pages a crawl, of about 1,200 Nordic start-up jobs (partial).

name: AppliTrack / Frontline
notes: Reads the embeddable posting list districts put on their own sites, www.applitrack.com/{district}/onlineapp/JobPostings/view.asp?embed=1&all=1 (robots.txt only closes the admin area). Descriptions are the posting text; some say only to open the attachment.

name: CHECK-IN by perbility
notes: Reads a portal's /list (10 a page, up to 5 pages, partial beyond) and the schema.org microdata on each job page at {portal}.mein-check-in.de (robots.txt allows it). Portals on www.mein-check-in.de/{customer}/ and jobs.perbility.de are other products and are not read.

name: Cegid DigitalRecruiters
notes: Career sites sit on the employer's own domain; the board is the site's sitemap and each /annonce/ page carries a schema.org JobPosting. These sites ask for a 10 second delay between requests, so reading 200 job pages takes over half an hour (partial).

name: Jibe
notes: Reads the JSON the career site's own job search calls (/api/jobs), on the employer's own domain; no login. Sites ask for a crawl delay of 5 seconds, which the fetcher honours.

name: JobScore
notes: Reads the company's public XML job feed on careers.jobscore.com; its robots.txt only disallows the apply flow.

name: softgarden
notes: Reads the schema.org job feed (jobs.feed.json) that each career page publishes for machines.

name: Get on Board
notes: Public API v0 of Get on Board (Latin America tech jobs), read per category. Its robots.txt allows search indexing and reserves AI training, so ERIO only indexes and links back; credit Get on Board and send candidates to the job's page there.

name: SOLID.Jobs
notes: Polish IT job board, read from each offer page's structured data via its sitemap (newest offers first); its robots.txt allows crawling outside /management/ and /admin/. A crawl reads at most 200 offers and is reported as partial. Credit SOLID.Jobs and link back.

name: Betterteam
blocked: Every request, even to its sitemap.xml, /jobs and /api/jobs, answers 403 with a 'Quick security check' bot-challenge page, so nothing can be read without passing it.

name: Workstream
blocked: Its documented API needs a bearer token; its public job pages (www.workstream.us/j/{id}/{company}) carry no feed or structured data, and the only company page found had no open jobs, so no way to read jobs was verified.

name: beesite
blocked: Career sites are built per customer on their own domains (the vendor says the career site is made together with the provider); no shared host, public feed or documented API was found, and none of the customer sites checked had structured job data.

name: Helix by perbility
blocked: perbility publishes only marketing pages (mein-helix.de); customer career sites are built per customer on their own domains and no public job feed or documented API was found.

name: Compleo
blocked: No vendor site, career-page host, feed or API for a platform of this name could be found (compleo.de refuses connections; compleet.com is a different company), so there is nothing to read.

name: inploi
blocked: Career sites are built per employer; inploi's own (careers.inploi.com) lists no jobs and has an empty sitemap, and no employer site with jobs, feed or API was found.

name: CATS
notes: Career portals on {account}.catsone.com are rendered on the server and read page by page; CATS's own API needs a key and is not used. Token is account/portalId.

name: HRM Direct / ClearCompany
notes: Old {tenant}.hrmdirect.com addresses redirect to apply.clearcompany.com/{tenant}; jobs come from the public job widget's feed, which the career page names by its site id.

name: concludis
notes: Reads the job list of a *.concludis.de career page and the JobPosting data on each job page. Boards that redirect to a customer's own domain are not read; only one live list board was found, so a second is still needed.

name: Feishu Hire
notes: Reads the anonymous CSRF token the site issues to every visitor, then the search the career site itself calls; no login. Token is tenant/path. A big board (ByteDance, Li Auto) is read in part and reported incomplete.

name: HERP
notes: Reads the schema.org JobPosting data on each job page linked from a herp.careers/v1/{company} list.

name: PyjamaHR
notes: Reads the career-page API of jobs.pyjamahr.com; PyjamaHR's account API needs a token and is not used. Token is company slug/company uuid from the career page's data.

name: Recruitify
notes: The portal's API picks the company by the portal address (Origin header). Only Recruitify's own portal was found, and its single job is a sample, so a second live board is still needed.

name: rexx systems
notes: Reads schema.org JobPosting data on each job page of a {customer}-portal.rexx-systems.com career portal.

name: Velora HR
notes: Reads the anonymous career-site API (api.velorahr.com/api/public/career-site/{id}/offers). Token is subdomain/id from the career-site address.

name: Jobylon
notes: Public job pages of emp.jobylon.com from its sitemap (schema.org JobPosting); robots.txt allows crawlers. Credit: link each job back to its Jobylon page.

name: SchoolSpring
notes: The anonymous API behind schoolspring.com (api.schoolspring.com); the token is an employer name used as the site's own search keyword. Credit: link each job back to its SchoolSpring page.

name: Airswift Jobs
notes: The staffing firm's own job pages (schema.org JobPosting), listed on airswift.com/jobs; robots.txt allows them. Credit: link each job back to its Airswift page.

name: Homerun
notes: Reads the Atom feed every Homerun career site advertises in its page head (feed.homerun.co/{tenant}); descriptions inline. Token is the career-site subdomain; the standing open-application entry is skipped.

name: HR Office
notes: Reads the career sites HR Office builds on employers' own domains: /sitemap.xml lists /vacatures/{id}-{slug} pages, each with a schema.org JobPosting. Only sites that publish that structured data are read (a bespoke site such as werkenbij.adver-online.nl has none). Token is the sitemap address.

name: RecrutOr
notes: Reads a RecrutOr career space (www.recrutor.pro/{tenant}/): the space's RSS feed lists the job pages, each with a schema.org JobPosting (place, employer, type). Token is the tenant name from the address.

name: TalentAdore
notes: Reads the position list a TalentAdore customer's career site embeds (ats.talentadore.com/positions/{code}/json, also /rss): title, unit, place, type and description inline. Token is the list code taken from that address; the career site's page names it.

name: Huntflow
notes: Reads Huntflow career sites ({tenant}.huntflow.io, {tenant}.global.huntflow.io): the sitemap lists /vacancy/{slug} pages, read from the server-rendered Nuxt payload (title, place, sections). Token is the site name, e.g. prisma or cryptopay.global. Archived vacancies are skipped.

name: Enlizt / Plooral
notes: Reads Plooral (Enlizt) career sites at {tenant}.enlizt.me: the server-rendered job list links /vagas/{slug} pages, each with a schema.org JobPosting. Token is the career-site address, e.g. https://dr.enlizt.me/. Sites with no open jobs list none.

name: SelfRecruit
blocked: no public vendor site or career pages found: selfrecruit.com is a parked domain for sale and no other selfrecruit domain resolves, so no tenant can be located
notes: Checked selfrecruit.com, www.selfrecruit.com and the .io/.fr/.de/.nl/.eu/.net/.it/.es/.co.uk variants on 2026-11-11; web search finds no career site powered by it.

name: Odoo Recruitment
notes: Reads the /jobs pages of Odoo websites: current versions mark each job up as a schema.org JobPosting (JSON-LD, or microdata on www.odoo.com); token is the https address of the site's /jobs list (paged as /jobs/page/n) or its sitemap. Themes and older versions with no structured data (for example jobsodoo.com) are not read.

name: BITE Bewerbermanager
notes: Reads the public job portal jobs.b-ite.com that BITE customers publish to: its sitemap lists /jobposting/{id} pages, each with a schema.org JobPosting naming the employer. robots.txt allows crawlers except the apply form. BITE customers' own career pages are not read. Credit: link each job back to its BITE page.

name: Tecla
notes: Reads the public job list the jobs page of app.tecla.io loads without sign-in (api.tecla.io/api/jobs/getPublicJobs/, paged): client company, remote role, USD pay range, short description and benefits. The list carries only a description excerpt. Token is https://api.tecla.io. Credit: link each job back to its Tecla page.

name: HR4YOU
notes: Reads HR4YOU career sites ({tenant}.hr4you.org): /sitemap.xml lists /job/view/{id}/... pages, each with a schema.org JobPosting. Token is the sitemap address. Some tenants (for example krh.hr4you.org) answer every request with a bot-check page and are not read; robots.txt allows only the list, view and sitemap paths.

name: HRworks
notes: Reads HRworks job portals (jobapplication.hrworks.de/de?companyId={id}, jobs.hrworks.de): the list page links each job as ?id={id} and each job page carries a schema.org JobPosting. Token is the portal's list address, taken from the career page.

name: RecruiterFlow
notes: Reads Recruiterflow career pages (recruiterflow.com/{tenant}/jobs): the page embeds the list of its jobs (window.jobsList) and each job page carries a schema.org JobPosting. Token is the career page address.

name: Talentio
notes: Reads Talentio (Japan) career pages: open.talentio.com/r/1/c/{company}/homes/{id} lists its job pages in the data it hands its page script, and each job page carries a schema.org JobPosting. Token is the company home page address. Pages that publish no JobPosting (and companies that only redirect elsewhere) list nothing.

name: Jobsoid
notes: Reads the JSON job list every Jobsoid career portal loads ({tenant}.jobsoid.com/api/v1/jobs): title, place, type, date and description inline; apply links use the portal's own or custom domain. Token is the portal subdomain. An unknown subdomain answers an empty list.

name: Occupop / Cezanne Recruitment
blocked: career sites (*.occupop-careers.com) are client-rendered apps that load jobs through a GraphQL gateway keyed by tenant, with no server-rendered jobs, feed or sitemap; the only static surface (api.occupop.com/api/jobs-frame/{embed id}) needs a per-employer embed id that only the employer's own site reveals, and only one such id was found, so no board can be discovered or two verified
notes: Checked royalsociety, brandalley, raisethebar, ourmedia, marlboroughgroup and europeanclimatefoundation .occupop-careers.com on 2026-11-11: each answers an empty app shell. The jobs-frame embed works for one employer's id (job pages at api.occupop.com/shared/job/{slug}); an owner decision is needed on registering boards by embed id.

name: Jobtoolz
blocked: robots.txt on every {tenant}.jobtoolz.com site says Disallow: /*? for all crawlers, which ERIO's fetcher reads as disallow-all (even the sitemap), so the career sites cannot be fetched
notes: Sites otherwise serve /sitemap.xml with /{language}/{job} pages carrying a schema.org JobPosting (checked stroom-maatwerk, stephex, eduard on 2026-11-11); the rule only bars URLs with a query string, so a robots parser fix (keep the trailing ? of a rule) would make them readable: owner decision.
